These three unmodified headers come from the `ros2` branch of
https://github.com/leggedrobotics/ocs2 (retrieved 2026-11-16):

- ocs2_core/include/ocs2_core/Types.h
- ocs2_core/include/ocs2_core/misc/LoadData.h
- ocs2_core/include/ocs2_core/misc/LoadStdVectorOfPair.h

Each header retains its original BSD license. They are included only for
compatibility tests of the actual OCS2 INFO loading functions, not runtime use.
